BruceWorx vendored add-ons (MOD-06, MOD-05)
===========================================

SheetMetal/  -- the SheetMetal workbench, installed as Mod/SheetMetal
  Upstream   https://github.com/shaise/FreeCAD_SheetMetal
  Version    0.8.26
  Commit     cbf6595b68ad015266923749c160c3555a72e1fd (2026-10-17,
             "Fix broken links, licence and typos in README (#628)")
  Licence    LGPL-2.1-or-later (LICENSE, package.xml). Eight files still carry
             GPL-2.0-or-later headers: SheetMetalCmd.py, ExtrudedCutout.py,
             SheetMetalCornerReliefCmd.py, SheetMetalFromSolid.py, SheetMetalHem.py,
             SheetMetalJunction.py, SheetMetalSketch.py, SheetMetalText.py. They are
             shipped as they are (see NOTICE); upstream is asked to align them.
  Taken      `git archive <commit>` of the upstream tree, minus .github/ and
             .vscode/ (FreeCAD's .gitignore skips dot folders).
  Needs      networkx >= 3.4.2, < 3.6 for the new unfolder (pixi.toml). Without it
             the add-on falls back to its old unfolder, and BruceWorx_ExportFlat
             writes bend lines without up/down (layer BEND).

Patches (applied to the tree above, in order; each is offered upstream):
  patches/0001-new-unfolder-k-factor-table-interpolation.patch
      BendAllowanceCalculator.get_k_factor used the first table segment for
      every ratio. One line.
  patches/0002-new-unfolder-headless-unfold-sketches.patch
      getUnfoldSketches set ViewObject properties without the GUI.
  Every changed line is marked "[BW]".

Updating (every BruceWorx release, decided 24 Oct 2026):
  1. In a clone of upstream: git archive <new commit> | tar -x -C SheetMetal.new
  2. Drop .github/ and .vscode/, then apply the patches in order:
       patch -p1 -d SheetMetal.new < patches/0001-...patch   (and 0002)
     A patch upstream has taken no longer applies: delete it here.
  3. Replace SheetMetal/ with SheetMetal.new, update this file (version, commit,
     the GPL file list: grep -L "Lesser" SheetMetal/*.py).
  4. Check the file lists in CMakeLists.txt still match (new top-level modules,
     Resources folders), rebuild, then run
       FreeCADCmd -t TestSheetMetal          (the add-on's own tests)
       FreeCADCmd -t TestBruceWorxSheetMetal (the bracket, rules and DXF)
     with networkx on the path.

A user copy wins: FreeCAD keys modules by lower-case folder name and reads the
user's Mod folder after the built-in one, so a SheetMetal installed from the
Addon Manager replaces this one; BruceWorx says so once in the status bar.

third-party/ -- licence texts installed to share/doc/BruceWorx/third-party/
  SheetMetal-LICENSE.txt is SheetMetal/LICENSE; networkx-LICENSE.txt is the
  BSD-3-Clause text of networkx 3.5 (shipped from the pixi environment).


fasteners/  -- the Fasteners workbench, installed as Mod/fasteners (MOD-05)
  Upstream   https://github.com/shaise/FreeCAD_FastenersWB
  Version    0.5.67 (tag V0.5.67-beta, the newest tag; master has not moved since)
  Commit     fddd07af422b7d3a69098b32333711c5eeae184c (package.xml dated 2025-09-10)
  Licence    GPL-2.0-or-later (LICENSE is the GPL-2 text; package.xml and the file
             headers agree). Shipped as it is, noted in NOTICE (FND-04): a Keystone
             build containing it is GPL-2.0-or-later as a whole.
  Folder     "fasteners", the Addon Manager's name, so a copy installed from the
             Addon Manager replaces this one (FreeCAD keys modules by folder name).
  Taken      25 Oct 2026, file by file from raw.githubusercontent.com at the tag, each
             checked against its git blob SHA-1 in GitHub's tree listing
             (api.github.com/repos/shaise/FreeCAD_FastenersWB/git/trees/<commit>?recursive=1).
             Left out: Resources/ (translations .qm/.ts and the README's pictures and
             screencast), Doc/, .env and .gitignore. Nothing at run time needs them;
             the menus are English without the translations.
  Needs      Nothing beyond FreeCAD (Part; Draft for its countersunk-holes tool). No
             network at run time: every size comes from FsData/*.csv.
  Patches    none.

Updating the Fasteners add-on:
  1. Note the new tag's commit, list its tree (the API URL above), fetch the files,
     check each blob SHA-1, drop the paths left out above.
  2. Replace fasteners/ with the new tree, update this entry.
  3. Rebuild, then run
       FreeCADCmd -t TestBruceWorxHardware   (an ISO 4762 M3x40 to the standard, the
                                              vault COTS item, nuts and inserts)
